title: George Knapp footage off Baja and the Tampico hotspot
summary: Jesse Michels tells of George Knapp footage off Baja and the Tampico hotspot, about unspecified at Mexico (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: George Knapp has interesting footage around Baja, Mexico. On the other side you have Tampico, which seems to be a hotspot.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a journalist named George Knapp has interesting footage of unexplained things filmed around Baja, on Mexico's Pacific side. Michels adds that across the country, on the other coast, the city of Tampico seems to be a hotspot for such sightings, which would make Mexico a place where these things keep turning up.
